title: FilterDirect Filter Subscriptions Cancellation Terms
content:
**Cancellation.** A FilterDirect Filter Subscriptions subscription may be cancelled at any time, with no fee where the grade's cancellation fee is $0.00. A cancellation received at least 3 calendar days before the ship date stops that shipment; a later one takes effect after that shipment ships. Shipments already sent are not refunded, except by the credits for damaged shipments and for shipments in a size other than the one on the subscription.

| Grade | Cancellation fee | Calendar days before the ship date to stop that shipment |
|---|---|---|
| FilterDirect Standard MERV 8 | $0.00 | 3 |
| FilterDirect Pleated MERV 11 | $0.00 | 3 |
| FilterDirect Allergen MERV 13 | $0.00 | 3 |
| FilterDirect Media Cabinet MERV 11 | $0.00 | 3 |
| FilterDirect Media Cabinet MERV 13 | $0.00 | 3 |
| FilterDirect Media Cabinet MERV 16 | $0.00 | 3 |

Every grade's cancellation fee is $0.00, so no grade charges a fee to cancel.

### From which status

A subscription can be cancelled while pending, before its first shipment, and while active or paused at the subscriber's request. A paused subscription is also cancelled when its pause runs past its limit.

### Cut-off boundary (ship date on the 5th)

| Cancellation received on | Calendar days before the 5th | That shipment |
|---|---|---|
| The 1st | 4 | Stopped |
| The 2nd | 3 | Stopped |
| The 3rd | 2 | Ships; the cancellation takes effect after it ships |
| The 5th | 0 | Ships; the cancellation takes effect after it ships |

### Basis questions

**A shipment went out before the cancellation reached the company. Is it refunded?** No, unless it qualifies for a damaged-shipment credit or a wrong-size credit.

**Does cancelling cost anything?** No. The fee is $0.00 for every grade.
